evidence: A/list.png: consistent card system with service line-icons; price in bold orange-red with small unit, time row separated by hairline
A/filter.png: selected chips carry a corner check mark as well as colour; 0 shown in both note and primary button
A/empty.png: selected-chip row plus three relax rows with real counts (6/4/1) and two buttons
B/empty.png: each relax row has a secondary line stating which conditions stay (仍是今天上门、可开发票), best-worded suggestions of the three
B/list.png: location and titles set with loose spaced middle dots (苏州 · 工业园区 · 星湖街, 日常保洁 · 3 小时), looser than A or C
B/filter.png: price ranges use a long em-dash (¥100—200); selected chips marked by border and tint only
C/list.png: a time block leads each card (今天 16:00 可上门), large numerals then name, black price at right; four cards above the fold, reading order is effortless
C/list.png: location set as 星湖街 bold large with 苏州 · 工业园区 small grey, clear typographic hierarchy; 上门费 ¥50 / 材料另计 set unambiguously
C/filter.png: top-right chip label truncated to 指定日期... (one clipped label); facts list 19 filter targets under 44 px

pairs.reason: A's type setting is tighter (no loose spaced dots or em-dash ranges) and its icons and check-marked chips give more finish; B's richer empty rows don't outweigh it.
C leads each card with a large time block and black prices, a scale system built for this task; A is a competent but generic card list.
C's time-first cards and location hierarchy show clear typographic intent and fit four services above the fold; B is a looser, more generic setting.

notes: A and B are close siblings (same palette and structure); C is the only arm with a distinct compositional idea. C's defects: one truncated filter label (指定日期...), and on its empty state neither button reads as primary. All arms pass measured contrast; capsule avoidance is clean in all three.
